now.title: The Punisher S1
now.text: Billy Russo was close to the Castle family as Frank's friend. He was secretly part of the plot behind their deaths.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's family, close to Billy, whose deaths he helped plot.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's friend, secretly part of the plot behind the Castles' deaths.

proposed.text: Billy Russo was close to the Castle family as Frank's best friend.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's family, who treat Billy as one of their own.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's best friend, close to the whole family.

split.title: The Punisher S1#12
split.text: Billy admits to Frank that he knew Rawlins and Schoonover planned the attack that killed the Castles. He told them he wanted no part of it, but did nothing to stop it.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's family. Billy knew of the plan to kill them and did nothing.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's best friend, who knew of the plan to kill the Castles and did nothing.

changes.evidence: Billy's knowledge of the massacre is only revealed in S1#12 'Home', where he tells Frank he wasn't there and told them he'd have no part of it, but admits he knew. He refused to take part rather than helping plot it. At season start the show only shows him as the family's close friend. The split's kind 'enemy' is a judgment call for the owner.

now.title: The Punisher S1#3
now.text: David Lieberman, known as Micro, tracks Frank down as a stranger. After a violent first meeting, the two agree to work together against those behind Cerberus.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Micro's new partner against Agent Orange.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A stranger who tracks Frank down, then a partner against Agent Orange.

proposed.title: The Punisher S1#2
proposed.text: Calling himself Micro, David Lieberman tracks Frank through the city's cameras and contacts him, leaving him footage of his old unit killing Ahmad Zubair. Frank stages getting hit by Sarah's car to draw him out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A man Micro tracks through the city's cameras and contacts.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A stranger who tracks Frank down and leaves him the Zubair footage.

split.title: The Punisher S1#3
split.text: David Lieberman, known as Micro, tracks Frank down as a stranger. After a violent first meeting, the two agree to work together against those behind Cerberus.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Micro's new partner against Agent Orange.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A stranger who tracks Frank down, then a partner against Agent Orange.

changes.evidence: S1#2 'Two Dead Men': Micro monitors cameras, tracks Castle and contacts him, telling him to look at a disc with the Zubair footage; Castle draws Lieberman out by getting hit by Sarah's car. The violent first meeting and partnership are S1#3 'Kandahar' (kept as split).

now.title: The Punisher S1#4
now.text: Frank Castle goes after Turk Barrett's shipment of guns, refusing to let the weapons end up in criminals' hands. He holds Turk at gunpoint and walks off with the armory he needs.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Gun dealer Frank holds at gunpoint to take his armory.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Turk at gunpoint and takes his guns.

proposed.text: Frank Castle ambushes gun dealer Turk Barrett and holds him at gunpoint, demanding weapons and ammo. Turk has only a crate of pink guns and no ammo, so Frank knocks him out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A gun dealer Frank holds at gunpoint, who has nothing worth taking.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Holds Turk at gunpoint for guns, then knocks him out.

changes.evidence: S1#4 'Resupply': Punisher ambushes Turk, who confesses he has little to sell (a pink gun for a gangster's daughter) and no ammo; Punisher knocks him out. Frank's armory comes from hijacking the Greek Mob shipment during the DHS operation, not from Turk.

now.title: The Marvels
now.text: Dar-Benn wants Kamala Khan's bangle to complete her pair. She attacks Kamala's family home in Jersey City to take it.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The bangle's holder, whose family home Dar-Benn attacks.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Kree leader who attacks Kamala's family home for her bangle.

proposed.text: On Aladna, Dar-Benn sees that Kamala Khan wears the second Quantum Band and demands it. At Earth's sun she takes Kamala hostage and tears the bangle off her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The girl with the second Quantum Band, whom Dar-Benn takes hostage for it.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Kree leader who takes Kamala hostage to seize her bangle.

changes.evidence: The Marvels: the Kree who attack the Khan home are two guards Goose swallowed and spits out there, and Dar-Benn is not present. Dar-Benn first learns of Kamala's band on Aladna ('In shock, Dar-Benn demanded to know where Khan got the band'). In the final fight she takes Kamala hostage under her hammer and grabs the second bangle.

now.text: Frigga raises Loki as her son and teaches him magic.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Frigga's son, whom she raises and teaches magic.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Loki's mother, who raises him and teaches him magic.

proposed.text: Frigga raises Loki as her son alongside Thor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Frigga's son, whom she raises alongside Thor.

changes.evidence: Thor (2011) never shows or mentions Frigga teaching Loki magic. The fandom cites only a Thor: The Dark World deleted scene (TTDWDS, not on screen) and Loki S1#3 (LK103), a later title.
